title: TRILLION GAME
description: Old schoolmates Haru and Gaku will do anything to achieve success. And success to them means earning a trillion dollars! But to do so, they’ll need to take full advantage of their own unique skills. Haru is a persuasive and confident speaker who can connect with anyone, while Gaku, although awkward, is an expert programmer. Will their combined talents be enough to make their dream a reality?

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Gaku possesses outstanding computer skills but is socially awkward. Haru's only talent is talking. After graduating from university, Haru wants to use Gaku's abilities to fulfill his childhood dream—to earn a trillion dollars.

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: After Haru blows their entire startup capital on an expensive office chair, the two young entrepreneurs set out to find a generous investor. There's only one problem: They haven't achieved anything, nor do they have any idea for their business model.

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Kirika offers to invest in Haru and Gaku for a 51% shareholding ratio, which would give her control over their company. Haru uses her offer as a weapon and enters a hacking tournament in order to attract other investors.

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: The preliminary phase of the Security Championship is nearing its conclusion. Will Haru and Gaku manage to secure a spot among the top 12 teams and reach the finals?

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Haru and Gaku compete as the only second team in the final round of the Security Championship. But right from the start, Haru demonstrates that he can contribute to the duo's victory even without IT skills.

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Gaku and Haru win the Security Championship, but they're disqualified after a complaint over their physical attack against the other competitors. However, investor Kedoin Kazuki is drawn to their abilities and reaches out to them.

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: With the name of the company settled, Haru and Gaku move on to hiring personnel. But which of the five applicants would be most suited to the job, especially when it hasn't been decided what the "job" is yet?

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: The trio is trying to launch an online shop where customers receive advice from a seemingly AI that appears as a VTuber avatar. Soon, they also discover which market they can specialize in.

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Haru and Gaku begin working as hosts in Shinjuku's Kabukicho to better understand their target market.

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Haru and Gaku's AI specialty shop catches the attention of Dragon Bank, who uses their media empire to bring them down. Not one to be beaten, Haru immediately begins preparing a counterattack.

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Trillion Game, Inc. invites investors to a private information session for their new social game project, which includes an appearance from a surprising guest.

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Haru and Kedoin visit God Promotion, Kedoin's former employer, to make a deal.

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Trillion Game, Inc. takes over God Promotion's shareholder meeting, and Gaku learns the shocking truth about Haru's plans for Sakura and his team of game designers.

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: Rinrin is furious when she learns the game development project was merely a pawn, but Gaku stops her from going to speak with Haru. If Gaku must fight Haru, then he'd rather do it his way. He reveals the situation to Sakura's team, and together they plan to create a game that exceeds what Haru planned for them. That said, it's a difficult task for a team that's never produced a hit game before.

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Gaku goes on a date with Kirihime to an amusement park. Though she seems to be enjoying herself like an ordinary girl, Gaku suspects that their "date" is a cover to discuss business.

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Gaku and Rinrin meet with Hebijima, the creator of Dragon Bank's hit game Dragon Musume, to offer him a job at Trillion Game, Inc. Negotiations immediately hit a snag when the topic of pay comes up.

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: Haru begins networking and making connections in order to build his media empire. Meanwhile, Rinrin has some bad news to share regarding the financial situation of Trillion Game, Inc.

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Haru fabricates a scandal in order to form a business alliance with Sumeragi Entertainment, the most powerful corporation in the industry.

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Trillion Game, Inc. brainstorms ways to get players to pay for a free mobile game.

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Gaku meets his high school crush at a class reunion.

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: President Kokuryu of Dragon Bank makes Gaku, Haru, and Kedoin an offer they have no reason to refuse.

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: Trillion Game, Inc. takes a company trip to Las Vegas.

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Trillion Game, Inc. goes head-to-head against Dragon Bank in the media industry.

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: Trillion Game, Inc. proposes a partnership with Kawara TV.

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: Trillion Game, Inc. and Kawara TV's Kunugi and Akari get to work producing Trillion News.

episodes_data.title: TRILLION GAME Season 1 Episode 26
episodes_data.description: Haru engineers a scenario in which Trillion News, Kawara TV, and the Mithril phone's manufacturer all come out ahead.
